I cheated. I was in California with my boyfriend of 3 years... He begged me to go spend the summer with him, and I wanted to travel and be anywhere but my parents' house. I knew the relationship would end that summer one way or another... He couldn't handle long distance, and he'd been getting more abusive in the months leading up, but I took the risk of going and at least seeing California instead of staying and hating my lonely life.

It was terrible. The emotional abuse got worse and worse throughout the summer, he spent 14-16 hours a day at his job and spent no time with me at all. I fell for his polar opposite, who happened to be my boss. He was older, knew how to make me feel cared about and respected. And he was sexy, so sexy. One night, a week before my flight back home was scheduled, my boyfriend threw my laptop across the room and I decided inwardly that I was done. I didn't say it, since I had a week left in the house we shared and I was scared to break it off while he still had that hanging over me.

The next day, all my coworkers went out for after work drinks and my crush came with us. Five cosmos in, I let slip my feelings for this guy. He ended up taking me salsa dancing and I just about died of desire. I stayed the night and had the best sex of my life.

I don't regret it. I would have ended the relationship if I had felt safe. I'd spent 3 years of college with this guy and I was dying to have some fun-- my (ex) boyfriend not only was abusive, he was also a workaholic who only wanted 30 seconds of sex every month. I was naive for believing it would get better. I think my California boy was exactly what I needed to get me out of that rut. I'm doing much better now and I have a wonderful boyfriend (a guy I had friend zoned for years) and he is everything. I would never, no matter what, cheat on him and he believes that.

Tl;dr: I cheated, once and never again. Extenuating circumstances, I don't regret it.

Let me start with those I've got experience with, but feel free to post your experiences with this or other kit sites in this discussion.

  • HLJ: middle-of-road prices and shipping, good for in-stock items, though gunpla tends to be out of stock fairly often here.
  • Hobbysearch: bargain bin sales, but slightly higher shipping, in general, than HLJ.
  • Amiami: cheaper prices than HLJ, but more expensive shipping (they overkill packaging since they typically ship more fragile figures) Very popular. Items go out of stock fairly quickly, but it's great for preorders.
  • Mandarake: Don't worry about labels of "damage". Moonland is extremely anal retentive about damage so a box with damage likely has a very minor bit of scuffing on it. This place is great for harder-to-find kits, such as clear versions or GFT kits.
  • Plamoya: occasionally they will have a bargain if you're familiar with the prices.
  • Banzai Hobby: halfchan /gunpla/'s newest, favorite website. Very cheap kits that are typically in stock with decent shipping. This site has really beat out a ton of domestic sites for a lot of us.

If you're not in USA, some of these aren't tenable:

  • Amazon/Ebay: they sometimes have nice deals. You can find some pretty nice bootlegs on Ebay for reasonable prices, and sometimes Amazon has ridiculously great deals.
  • Hobbywave: best for bulk purchases because of flat $12 USD shipping, regardless of number of kits.
  • Gundamplanet: a bit more expensive, but fast if you're in the tristate area, and they often have kits in stock that other places don't.
  • GGinfinite: run by the gundam blogspot guy, it's a bit more expensive, but they have P-Bandai stuff for… not scalper prices at least.
Good sites to buy Gunpla/Plamo Kits
Fortunately for me Tatsu Hobby is in my area (Bay area, California), but they have an online ordering website as well.

For the UK folks you have two options (as far as I'm aware):

  • Gundam Mad: These guys can be kinda pricey but they carry a fairly decent range from HG-PG and also occasionally stock models from outside of the gundam universe. If you visit almost any UK convention they're usually in the dealers room which can save you some money on shipping. I havent used them for a while but I mostly remember them being pretty good and no import tax as I remember due to them shipping within the UK.

  • Gunpla UK: Pretty much run by one guy who gets the models shipped directly from Japan to you. I've ordered my most recent kits from here and whilst waiting for shipping can be a pain I've never had a problem. Import tax is gonna be a part of purchasing here. However on the upside, if you contact the guy who runs the site, he can pretty much place an order for almost any kit, so it always helps to ask here if Gundam Mad appear to be out of stock of something you're after.

Hope that was helpful for any UK buyers looking to find a place to pick up kits.
